# PHREEQC-generated files

Add the PHREEQC files generated during the manuscript runs here. The Python workflow writes temperature-specific PHREEQC input (`.pqi`), standard output (`.out`) and selected-output (`.txt`) files. C3 and C5 subfolders are provided for organization.

These files are intentionally not bundled in the prepared archive because the author indicated that they will be added separately.
